sloka: निर्जित्य राक्षसेन्द्रस्तं धनदं हृष्टमानसः ।पुष्पकं तस्य जग्राह विमानं जयलक्षणम् ।। ७.१५.३८ ॥
transliteration: nirjitya rākṣasendrastaṁ dhanadaṁ hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ।puṣpakaṁ tasya jagrāha vimānaṁ jayalakṣaṇam ।। 7.15.38 ॥

translations.english: Having conquered Kubera, the lord of Rakshasas, Ravana, with a joyful mind, took his Pushpaka aerial chariot, which was a symbol of victory.
